conventions.uiToolkit: Jetpack Compose + Material 3, dark theme only
conventions.architecturePattern: MVVM with unidirectional data flow over ui -> domain -> data
conventions.permittedException: core/format may depend on domain/model value objects only (NutritionValues). No other core -> domain edge is permitted.
definitionOfDone: ./gradlew build test compiles and all tests pass
Unit tests written for the behaviour added in this layer
No direct System.currentTimeMillis() / LocalDate.now() / Dispatchers.IO call sites; use TimeProvider and injected dispatchers
Rounding is presentation-only; storage and arithmetic stay unrounded Double

layers.name: Foundation and build scaffold
layers.goal: A buildable, installable, empty Hilt + Compose application with the full package skeleton and dependency catalogue in place.

components.name: Gradle scaffold
components.responsibility: AGP 8.9+, Gradle 8.11+, Kotlin 2.1.x, KSP, Hilt plugin, kotlinx-serialization plugin, Compose compiler plugin, core library desugaring enabled, minSdk 29 / compileSdk 36 / targetSdk 36, JVM target 17, Room schema export arg pointing at app/schemas.

components.name: Version catalog
components.responsibility: Single source of dependency truth. Populate every library listed in architecture.md section 4.1 even if unused until a later layer.

components.name: HungryWalrusApplication
components.responsibility: @HiltAndroidApp; implements Configuration.Provider supplying HiltWorkerFactory. Remove the default WorkManagerInitializer via androidx.startup node removal in the manifest.

components.name: MainActivity
components.responsibility: @AndroidEntryPoint, single activity, edge-to-edge, sets HungryWalrusTheme and a placeholder composable (NavHost arrives in L09).

components.name: Manifest
components.responsibility: INTERNET permission, CAMERA permission, uses-feature camera required=false, dark-only launcher theme, dataExtractionRules and backup_rules resources referenced (contents filled in L05).

components.name: Theme skeleton
components.responsibility: Colour, Type, Shape, HungryWalrusTheme. Dark colour scheme only, no light theme resources, no values-night duplication. Final palette comes from design.md; a neutral placeholder is acceptable here.

components.name: Package skeleton
components.responsibility: Create the empty package tree exactly as specified in architecture.md 3.3 so later sessions place files consistently.

acceptanceCriteria: ./gradlew build test passes on a clean checkout
App installs and launches to a blank dark screen on an API 29 emulator
Hilt graph builds with zero bindings
app/schemas directory exists and is committed
tests: Smoke test that HungryWalrusApplication is annotated and the Hilt test runner starts (hilt-android-testing)
risks: Version skew between AGP/Kotlin/Compose compiler/KSP is the most common cause of a broken scaffold. Pin all four in the catalog and record the exact versions in the session notes.

layers.name: Core primitives
layers.goal: The cross-cutting primitives every later layer depends on: result/error model, injectable time, injectable dispatchers.

components.name: AppResult / DataError
components.responsibility: Sealed AppResult<out T> with Success(data, isStale = false) and Failure(error). Sealed DataError with NoConnectivity, Timeout, NotFound, Unauthorized, RateLimited(retryAfterSeconds), BadRequest, ServerError(code), Malformed, Unknown(cause). Include map/fold helpers.

components.name: TimeProvider
components.responsibility: Interface with now(): Instant, today(): LocalDate, zone(): ZoneId. SystemTimeProvider backed by java.time.Clock. This is the only permitted source of current time in the app.

components.name: DateRange
components.responsibility: Inclusive LocalDate range value object with epoch-day accessors for DAO queries.

components.name: Dispatcher qualifiers
components.responsibility: @IoDispatcher, @DefaultDispatcher, @MainDispatcher qualifier annotations.

components.name: DispatcherModule / TimeModule
components.responsibility: Hilt @Module @InstallIn(SingletonComponent) providing the dispatchers, Clock, ZoneId and TimeProvider.

acceptanceCriteria: A fixed Clock can be injected in tests and observably changes TimeProvider.today()
No production code references Dispatchers.IO or LocalDate.now() directly
tests: TimeProvider with a fixed Clock across a timezone boundary
DateRange inclusivity and epoch-day conversion
AppResult map/fold semantics including isStale propagation

layers.name: Domain model, calculators and repository contracts
layers.goal: All pure business logic, unit tested without Android. This is the highest-value test layer in the app.

components.name: Domain models
components.responsibility: NutritionValues (with plus, times, ZERO), PartialNutrition, NutritionPlan, LogEntry, LogEntryDraft, Recipe, RecipeDraft, RecipeIngredient, FoodItem, FoodSource, LabelBasis, MacroField, DailyProgress, RollingSummary. All immutable.

components.name: NutritionRounding + NutritionFormatter
components.responsibility: Presentation-only rounding: kcal to nearest whole number, macros to nearest 0.5 g, both half-away-from-zero. Formatter uses Locale.UK, renders a decimal place only when the rounded macro has a fractional part. Never used inside storage or aggregation.

components.name: ScaleNutritionUseCase
components.responsibility: consumed = per100g * (weightG / 100). Rejects weightG <= 0.

components.name: ScaleRecipePortionUseCase
components.responsibility: factor = portionWeightG / recipe.totalWeightG; consumed = totals * factor. Explicit guard returning failure when totalWeightG <= 0.

components.name: RecipeTotalsCalculator
components.responsibility: totalWeightG = sum(weightG); totals = sum(per100g * weightG / 100). Single function used both for the live running total and for persisted totals.

components.name: RollingWindowCalculator
components.responsibility: SUMMARY_CUTOFF_HOUR = 20 private constant. endDay = today if hour >= 20 else yesterday; startDay = endDay - (windowDays - 1); inclusive range.

components.name: ValidateNutritionPlanUseCase
components.responsibility: kcal must parse and be > 0; protein/carbs/fat must parse and be >= 0 (zero valid). Returns per-field errors.

components.name: DetectMissingNutrientsUseCase
components.responsibility: Returns Set<MacroField> of null per-100g values. 0.0 is a legitimate value and is NOT missing.

components.name: Repository interfaces
components.responsibility: NutritionPlanRepository, LogEntryRepository, RecipeRepository, FoodLookupRepository, SettingsRepository exactly as specified in architecture.md 7.1. Interfaces only; no implementations in this layer.

acceptanceCriteria: domain package contains no android.*, androidx.room.*, retrofit2.* or serialization imports
Every calculator is exercised at its boundary values
tests: Rounding at .25 / .75 / x.x5 boundaries and for negative (overage) values
Sum-first-round-last: summing unrounded then rounding differs from rounding then summing, and the former is what is produced
20:00 window boundary at 19:59, 20:00 and 23:59, and across month and year ends
Recipe portion scaling with totalWeightG == 0 returns failure and does not produce NaN
Plan validation accepts a zero macro target and rejects zero kcal
DetectMissingNutrients treats 0.0 as present and null as missing

layers.name: Room persistence
layers.goal: The complete database schema at version 1 with all DAOs and their queries, verified by instrumentation tests.

components.name: Entities
components.responsibility: NutritionPlanEntity, LogEntryEntity, RecipeEntity, RecipeIngredientEntity (FK to recipe, ON DELETE CASCADE, indexed), FoodCacheEntity (composite PK source+external_id, nullable macro columns), SearchQueryCacheEntity, SearchResultRefEntity (FK cascade). Column names and nullability exactly as tabulated in architecture.md section 6.

components.name: Converters
components.responsibility: FoodSource <-> String and LabelBasis <-> String only. Dates stored as epoch millis / epoch day primitives, converted in mappers not converters.

components.name: HungryWalrusDatabase
components.responsibility: version = 1, exportSchema = true, database file hungry_walrus.db. fallbackToDestructiveMigration is forbidden.

components.name: LogEntryDao
components.responsibility: observeEntriesForDay, observeTotalsForDay, observeTotalsInRange, observeDaysWithEntriesInRange, insert, deleteById, deleteOlderThan(cutoffDay). Aggregates return a null-column row when empty; mapping to 0.0 happens in the repository layer.

components.name: NutritionPlanDao
components.responsibility: observeActivePlanOn(day), observeLatestPlan, getPlansEffectiveUpTo(day), deleteForDay(day), insert. Active plan = greatest effective_from_day <= day, tie-break created_at then id.

components.name: RecipeDao
components.responsibility: observeAllRecipes (ORDER BY name COLLATE NOCASE), observeRecipeWithIngredients (@Transaction + @Relation, ingredients ordered by position), getRecipeWithIngredients, saveRecipe (@Transaction upsert -> delete ingredients -> insert), deleteRecipe, countRecipes.

components.name: FoodCacheDao
components.responsibility: get, getAll(source, ids), upsertAll (REPLACE), touch(last_accessed_at), deleteFetchedBefore, count, deleteLeastRecentlyUsed(keepCount).

components.name: SearchCacheDao
components.responsibility: getQuery, getResults (ORDER BY rank), saveResults (@Transaction), deleteFetchedBefore.

components.name: DatabaseModule
components.responsibility: Provides the database and every DAO as @Singleton.

acceptanceCriteria: Exported schema JSON for version 1 committed under app/schemas
No foreign key from log_entry to recipe
recipe_ingredient per-100g columns are NOT NULL; food_cache macro columns are nullable
tests: androidTest with in-memory Room: day-bucketed aggregation totals
deleteOlderThan boundary at exactly the cutoff day (cutoff row retained, day before deleted)
Active-plan resolution across multiple plan rows including two rows on the same effective day
saveRecipe transaction replaces the ingredient set atomically
Deleting a recipe cascades to ingredients and leaves log entries untouched
deleteLeastRecentlyUsed evicts strictly by last_accessed_at ascending

layers.name: Local repositories, preferences and backup rules
layers.goal: Working plan, log-entry and recipe repositories over Room, plus the DataStore preference store.

components.name: Entity <-> domain mappers
components.responsibility: Bidirectional mapping. Room entities and DTOs never leave the data package.

components.name: NutritionPlanRepositoryImpl
components.responsibility: observeActivePlan (today, driven by TimeProvider), observePlanOn, getPlanHistoryUpTo, savePlan stamping effectiveFrom = today via @Transaction deleteForDay + insert (append-only history, never update).

components.name: LogEntryRepositoryImpl
components.responsibility: Day-bucketed reads mapping null aggregates to NutritionValues.ZERO; addEntry computing logged_on_day from the device zone at logging time; deleteEntry; purgeOlderThan.

components.name: RecipeRepositoryImpl
components.responsibility: List reads without ingredients, detail reads with ingredients ordered by position, saveRecipe recomputing totals with RecipeTotalsCalculator inside the same transaction, deleteRecipe.

components.name: AppPreferencesDataStore
components.responsibility: DataStore Preferences for non-secret values: lastMaintenanceRun, last selected summary window.

components.name: Backup rules
components.responsibility: backup_rules.xml and data_extraction_rules.xml excluding the DataStore file that will hold the encrypted API key (L05).

components.name: RepositoryModule / PreferencesModule
components.responsibility: @Binds for the three local repositories; provides DataStore.

acceptanceCriteria: Saving a plan twice on the same day yields exactly one row for that day
A recipe edit does not alter any previously saved log entry
Empty day returns NutritionValues.ZERO, not null
tests: Repository tests against in-memory Room covering plan history semantics, same-day replace, recipe totals recomputation on save, and zero-mapping of empty aggregates

layers.name: Secure USDA API key storage
layers.goal: The USDA key present at runtime, encrypted at rest, absent from VCS, backups and logs, with a user-supplied override path.

components.name: Build-time injection
components.responsibility: Read usda.api.key from local.properties (git-ignored) or the USDA_API_KEY environment variable; expose as a BuildConfig field. Never commit the value. Absent key must still produce a working build.

components.name: KeystoreCrypto
components.responsibility: AES-256 key in the Android Keystore under alias hw_usda_key, AES/GCM/NoPadding, setUserAuthenticationRequired(false), StrongBox when FEATURE_STRONGBOX_KEYSTORE is available with graceful fallback. Fresh random 12-byte IV per write; store Base64 of iv || ciphertext. Handles KeyPermanentlyInvalidatedException and UnrecoverableKeyException by discarding ciphertext, regenerating the key and re-seeding; never crashes.

components.name: ApiKeyStore
components.responsibility: On first read, seeds from BuildConfig and persists only ciphertext. Exposes the plaintext key to exactly one consumer (UsdaApiKeyInterceptor). User override takes precedence when set.

components.name: SettingsRepositoryImpl
components.responsibility: observeUserApiKeyPresent (boolean only, never the value), setUserApiKey(null clears), lastMaintenanceRun accessors.

components.name: SecurityModule
components.responsibility: Provides KeystoreCrypto and ApiKeyStore as @Singleton.

acceptanceCriteria: No plaintext key on disk, in logs, or in any UiState
Ciphertext DataStore file is excluded from backup and device transfer
A corrupted or invalidated Keystore entry recovers silently rather than crashing
tests: androidTest round-trip encrypt/decrypt
Distinct IV per write
Simulated invalidated-key recovery path
Unit test that the user override wins over the BuildConfig seed
risks: Accepted and documented: a key shipped in a client binary is extractable. Mitigations are scope-limited to VCS, backup, log and cross-app exposure. Open Food Facts needs no key, so a USDA key loss degrades one of four entry methods only.

layers.name: USDA and Open Food Facts clients
layers.goal: Both API clients with DTOs, mappers, interceptors and a single error mapping path, fully covered by MockWebServer tests.

components.name: NetworkModule
components.responsibility: Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; coerceInputValues = true; explicitNulls = false }; one shared OkHttpClient core (connect 15s, read 20s, write 15s, retryOnConnectionFailure) with per-API newBuilder(); @UsdaRetrofit and @OffRetrofit qualified Retrofit instances; no OkHttp disk cache.

components.name: Interceptors
components.responsibility: ConnectivityInterceptor throwing NoConnectivityException before opening a socket; UserAgentInterceptor setting HungryWalrus/<versionName> (Android <osVersion>; <repoUrl>) which is mandatory for OFF; UsdaApiKeyInterceptor appending the api_key query parameter (the only reader of the plaintext key); HttpLoggingInterceptor debug-only with api_key redacted.

components.name: UsdaApiService + DTOs + UsdaFoodMapper
components.responsibility: GET foods/search (query, dataType=Foundation,SR Legacy,Survey (FNDDS), pageSize=25, pageNumber, requireAllWords=false) and GET food/{fdcId} (format=full, nutrients=1008,1003,1005,1004,1062). Branded data type explicitly excluded. Nutrient ids 1008 kcal, 1062 kJ fallback (kcal = kJ / 4.184, sets energyDerivedFromKj), 1003 protein, 1005 carbs, 1004 fat. Values are per 100 g; labelBasis = PER_100G. Absent nutrient stays null, never 0.

components.name: OpenFoodFactsApiService + DTOs + OffProductMapper
components.responsibility: GET cgi/search.pl (search_terms, search_simple=1, action=process, json=1, page_size=25, page) and GET api/v2/product/{barcode}.json, both with fields=code,product_name,brands,quantity,serving_size,nutrition_data_per,nutriments. Energy preference energy-kcal_100g then energy-kj_100g/4.184 then energy_100g/4.184 when unit is kJ. Per-serving derivation only when serving_size parses to grams; millilitre-only serving sizes are unparseable and force labelBasis = PER_100G.

components.name: BarcodeNormaliser
components.responsibility: Strip whitespace; left-pad 12-digit UPC-A to 13 digits; query 8-digit EAN-8 as-is. Single shared implementation used by both the scanner and the cache key builder.

components.name: ErrorMapper
components.responsibility: The only Throwable/HTTP-status to DataError conversion. Includes 403 -> Unauthorized (USDA only), 429 -> RateLimited(retryAfterSeconds), 5xx -> ServerError, SerializationException -> Malformed.

components.name: Remote data sources
components.responsibility: UsdaRemoteDataSource and OpenFoodFactsRemoteDataSource. No caching knowledge. OFF data source MUST inspect the JSON status field and map status == 0 to DataError.NotFound despite HTTP 200.

acceptanceCriteria: Barcode lookups never touch USDA
USDA queries never request the Branded data type
Every OFF request carries the descriptive User-Agent
tests: MockWebServer happy path for both APIs
OFF HTTP 200 with status: 0 maps to NotFound (mandatory, highest-risk integration bug)
kJ-only energy payloads on both sources convert at 4.184 exactly once
Payloads missing one, two and all four macros produce nulls, not zeros
403, 429, 500, malformed JSON and socket timeout each map to the correct DataError
BarcodeNormaliser padding for 8, 12 and 13 digit inputs
risks: OFF cgi/search.pl is the legacy full-text endpoint and is the highest-likelihood external breakage in this design. Keep it isolated behind the service + mapper pair so a swap touches two files.

layers.name: Food cache and lookup repository
layers.goal: Cache-first food lookup with stale fallback, implementing the mandated offline behaviour.

components.name: CachePolicy
components.responsibility: Constants in one testable object: FOOD_FRESH_TTL = 30 days, FOOD_HARD_EXPIRY = 180 days, SEARCH_FRESH_TTL = 24 hours, SEARCH_HARD_EXPIRY = 7 days, FOOD_CACHE_MAX_ROWS = 2000, FOOD_CACHE_LOW_WATERMARK = 1600.

components.name: FoodCacheDataSource
components.responsibility: Reads/writes food_cache and the search caches, classifies fresh/stale/miss against CachePolicy using TimeProvider, and bumps last_accessed_at on every read. Query key = query.trim().lowercase() with internal whitespace collapsed.

components.name: FoodLookupRepositoryImpl
components.responsibility: One algorithm for every lookup: fresh cache hit returns immediately with no network call; otherwise attempt network, upsert on success; on failure return the cached record with isStale = true when within hard expiry, else Failure. searchGeneric (USDA), searchBranded (OFF), lookupBarcode (OFF only), getFoodDetail. Search responses pre-populate food_cache for the whole result page so the search -> weight path costs one round trip.

components.name: User estimate write-back
components.responsibility: When the user supplies estimates for missing macros, write them into food_cache leaving fetched_at unchanged so an estimate never masquerades as fresh API data.

acceptanceCriteria: A failed lookup with no usable cache returns a Failure that the UI can turn into the manual-entry suggestion
A fresh cache hit performs zero network calls
isStale is true only when serving a cached record after a network failure
tests: Fresh hit -> no network
Stale within hard expiry + network failure -> Success(isStale = true)
Beyond hard expiry + network failure -> Failure
No cache + NoConnectivity -> Failure(NoConnectivity)
last_accessed_at updated on read
Estimate write-back leaves fetched_at unchanged

layers.name: Retention and cache maintenance worker
layers.goal: Automatic 2-year log retention and cache eviction that actually runs on real devices.

components.name: DataMaintenanceWorker
components.responsibility: @HiltWorker CoroutineWorker performing, in order: purge log entries older than today.minusYears(2) (calendar arithmetic, not 730 days); delete expired search cache rows (cascades to refs); delete food_cache rows past hard expiry; LRU-evict food_cache down to the low watermark when above the cap; record lastMaintenanceRun. Never touches nutrition_plan or recipes.

components.name: MaintenanceScheduler
components.responsibility: PeriodicWorkRequest every 24h with ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.KEEP and requiresBatteryNotLow, enqueued from Application.onCreate; plus an opportunistic one-shot on cold start when lastMaintenanceRun is older than 24h.

acceptanceCriteria: Retention boundary is calendar-correct across a leap year
Recipes and plan history are never deleted
Worker is idempotent and safe to run repeatedly
tests: Worker test with a fixed Clock covering the 2-year boundary exactly, leap-year handling, TTL purge, LRU eviction to the watermark, and a no-op run when nothing is eligible
risks: Silent deletion with no user warning is as specified in the requirements. Flagged for the product owner in architecture.md section 17.

layers.name: UI shell: theme, navigation and shared components
layers.goal: The navigation skeleton and the shared composables every screen layer reuses.

components.name: Routes
components.responsibility: Type-safe @Serializable route objects/classes for the four tab roots, the AddEntryGraph destinations and the RecipeEditorGraph destinations, exactly as inventoried in architecture.md 12.3. Route arguments carry identifiers only.

components.name: HungryWalrusNavHost + BottomNavBar
components.responsibility: Single NavHost, start destination Today. Four tabs with per-tab back stacks using saveState/restoreState, launchSingleTop and popUpTo(startDestination). Bottom bar hidden on add-entry, recipe editor and scanner destinations.

components.name: Shared components
components.responsibility: MacroRow, ProgressBarGroup, WeightInput, NutritionSummaryCard, ConfirmDialog, ErrorState (with a manual-entry call to action), EmptyState, StaleDataBadge. Visual specification comes from design.md.

components.name: Theme finalisation
components.responsibility: Apply the design.md dark palette, typography and shapes. No light theme.

acceptanceCriteria: Tab switching preserves each tab's back stack
Back from a non-Today tab root returns to Today; back on Today exits
Screens are placeholders at this stage; no business logic here
tests: Compose tests for tab back-stack preservation and bottom-bar visibility rules

layers.name: Settings and nutrition plan
layers.goal: The only place the nutrition plan is managed, plus the USDA key override.

components.name: SettingsViewModel / SettingsUiState
components.responsibility: Plan form state backed by observeLatestPlan, per-field validation via ValidateNutritionPlanUseCase, save via NutritionPlanRepository.savePlan. Custom key state exposed as a boolean presence flag only. Events via a Channel.

components.name: SettingsScreen
components.responsibility: Plan targets form (kcal > 0, macros >= 0 with zero valid), USDA key override field showing only a masked 'Custom key set' indicator, about/version. No separate plan screen exists.

acceptanceCriteria: Zero macro target is accepted; zero kcal target is rejected with a field error
Saving a plan writes a new effective-from-today row and does not modify history
The plaintext custom key is never present in UiState
tests: ViewModel validation emissions per field
Save path produces a new plan row
Compose test for error, empty and populated form states

layers.name: Today / daily progress
layers.goal: Daily intake versus plan with progress bars and numerics, plus entry deletion.

components.name: GetDailyProgressUseCase
components.responsibility: Combines observeTotalsForDay(today) with observeActivePlan(); remaining = targets - consumed (negative means overage); plan and remaining are null when no plan exists.

components.name: TodayViewModel / TodayUiState
components.responsibility: Flow-only composition so a plan saved in Settings updates the notice immediately with no navigation round trip. No one-shot plan read anywhere in this path. Recomputes 'today' on resume to survive midnight rollover. Pre-formats display strings.

components.name: TodayScreen
components.responsibility: Progress bars (unrounded fractions) plus rounded numerics, today's entry list newest first, delete with confirmation dialog, FAB into the add-entry flow, and the 'set up a plan in Settings' notice when no plan exists.

acceptanceCriteria: Saving a plan in Settings clears the no-plan notice without navigating away and back
Progress bar can read 100% while the rounded numeric label appears slightly under; this is intentional
Deleting an entry always requires confirmation
tests: ViewModel test asserting the plan-saved-updates-immediately requirement
Overage rendering with negative remaining
Compose tests for empty, no-plan, populated and delete-confirmation states

layers.name: Rolling summaries
layers.goal: 7-day and 28-day cumulative intake versus cumulative plan target, always fresh on tab entry.

components.name: GetRollingSummaryUseCase
components.responsibility: Uses RollingWindowCalculator for the window, observeTotalsInRange for intake, and sums the plan active on each day from getPlanHistoryUpTo(endDay) in Kotlin. Exposes daysWithPlan so a partially covered window can be caveated.

components.name: SummariesViewModel / SummariesUiState
components.responsibility: MUST recompute the window on every screen resume via a refresh trigger MutableStateFlow pulsed from a lifecycle resume effect and combined with flatMapLatest. stateIn(WhileSubscribed(5000)) alone is insufficient because the subscription never stops on a tab switch.

components.name: SummariesScreen
components.responsibility: 7-day / 28-day toggle, cumulative intake beside cumulative plan target, and the explicit window date range so the 20:00 rule is legible to the user.

acceptanceCriteria: Logging an entry then switching to Summaries shows updated totals, never a stale snapshot
Before 20:00 the window ends yesterday; from 20:00 it ends today
Cumulative plan target is correct across a window that spans a plan change
tests: ViewModel test: resume trigger recomputes across the 20:00 boundary with a fixed Clock
Cumulative target across a mid-window plan change
Window with no plan for part of the period reports daysWithPlan correctly

layers.name: Add-entry flow core: method, manual entry and confirmation
layers.goal: The multi-step entry flow skeleton with graph-scoped draft state, the manual entry path and the save-on-confirm path.

components.name: AddEntryFlowViewModel
components.responsibility: Scoped to AddEntryGraph via hiltViewModel(remember { navController.getBackStackEntry(graphRoute) }). Holds the draft across method -> search -> detail -> confirm. SavedStateHandle for scalar fields only; full draft restoration is best-effort.

components.name: EntryMethodScreen
components.responsibility: Choose generic search / branded search / scan barcode / manual entry / from recipe.

components.name: ManualEntryScreen
components.responsibility: Name plus FINAL as-consumed kcal/protein/carbs/fat. NO weight field and no scaling. This is the resolved conflict in architecture.md 1.1: requirements.md governs.

components.name: EntryConfirmScreen
components.responsibility: Validation summary with confirm and go-back-and-edit actions. Confirm saves the log entry and pops the whole graph back to Today. Back from here preserves the previous step's input.

acceptanceCriteria: Manual log entries have no weight input and store the values as entered
Leaving the graph discards the draft
Confirm is the only path that writes to the database
tests: ViewModel draft lifecycle including discard on graph exit
Manual entry save path stores unscaled values
Compose tests for the confirm screen's summary and go-back behaviour

layers.name: Food search, detail and missing-nutrient completion
layers.goal: The API-backed entry paths, including the mandatory offline and incomplete-data behaviours.

components.name: FoodSearchScreen + ViewModel
components.responsibility: Query field, debounced search, result list. Generic (USDA) results display per 100 g; branded (OFF) results display on the package-label basis, rendering per100g * serving_size_g / 100 annotated with serving_label when labelBasis is PER_SERVING. Stale results carry a cache indicator.

components.name: FoodDetailScreen + ViewModel
components.responsibility: Selected item, mandatory weight input with live scaled preview via ScaleNutritionUseCase. Weight must be > 0.

components.name: MissingNutrientsScreen
components.responsibility: Shown only when DetectMissingNutrientsUseCase returns a non-empty set. Blocks save until every missing value has an estimate; present values remain editable. Estimates are written back to the cache without altering fetched_at.

components.name: Offline/error handling
components.responsibility: On failure with no usable cache, show a clear message offering manual entry as the immediate next action, with a direct affordance into ManualEntryScreen carrying the query text as a pre-filled name.

acceptanceCriteria: A lookup failure with no cache always offers manual entry; the flow is never a dead end
An entry with any missing core macro cannot be saved
Stale cached data is visibly indicated but remains fully usable and savable
tests: ViewModel gating: save blocked while a macro is missing
Offline failure emits the manual-entry suggestion state
Label-basis rendering for a PER_SERVING product with and without a parseable gram serving size

layers.name: Barcode scanning
layers.goal: CameraX + bundled ML Kit scanning into the Open Food Facts lookup, with a complete permission story.

components.name: BarcodeAnalyzer
components.responsibility: ML Kit bundled model restricted to EAN_13, EAN_8, UPC_A, UPC_E. Requires the same value in two consecutive successful frames before emitting, then stops analysis.

components.name: BarcodeScanScreen + ViewModel
components.responsibility: CameraX Preview + ImageAnalysis (STRATEGY_KEEP_ONLY_LATEST, back camera, dedicated single-thread executor), provider bound to the composable LifecycleOwner and released on dispose. Torch toggle when a flash unit is reported. Emitted value goes through BarcodeNormaliser to FoodLookupRepository.lookupBarcode. Never queries USDA.

components.name: Permission handling
components.responsibility: Requested at point of use, never at launch. Rationale dialog explaining that the camera reads barcodes only and no images are stored or transmitted. Permanent denial falls back to manual barcode text entry feeding the same OFF lookup, plus a deep link to app settings.

acceptanceCriteria: No ImageCapture use case is bound and no image is written to disk
Denied or permanently denied permission never produces a dead end
A single misread frame cannot produce a lookup
tests: BarcodeAnalyzer two-consecutive-frame debounce with unit-testable frame inputs
Normalisation applied before lookup
Compose tests for permission granted, denied and permanently-denied states

layers.name: Recipes: list, editor, ingredients and portion logging
layers.goal: Full recipe lifecycle including the Revision 2 in-place ingredient edit dialog, and logging a portion of a recipe.

components.name: RecipeListScreen + ViewModel
components.responsibility: Recipes with totals, create, open for edit, delete with confirmation. Recipes are never auto-deleted.

components.name: RecipeEditorViewModel
components.responsibility: Scoped to RecipeEditorGraph. Holds the in-memory ingredient list and live running totals computed by RecipeTotalsCalculator. Nothing is persisted until the user saves the recipe.

components.name: RecipeEditorScreen
components.responsibility: Name, ingredient list, live running totals updating as ingredients are added, add/remove, save. Back with unsaved changes prompts DiscardChangesDialog.

components.name: Ingredient sub-screens
components.responsibility: Ingredient-mode reuse of EntryMethodScreen, FoodSearchScreen, BarcodeScanScreen and FoodDetailScreen, plus ManualIngredientScreen. Every ingredient carries a weight AND per-100g values regardless of source (this differs from a manual log entry, which has neither).

components.name: IngredientEditDialog
components.responsibility: Revision 2. Opened by tapping an ingredient row in edit mode, pre-populated with current values. Weight always editable; name and per-100g kcal/protein/carbs/fat editable for every source including USDA and OFF. Confirm updates the in-memory list and recomputes totals immediately; cancel discards that ingredient's changes. UI/ViewModel only, no schema or DAO change.

components.name: RecipePickerScreen + RecipePortionScreen
components.responsibility: Choose a saved recipe, enter the weight consumed, live scaled preview via ScaleRecipePortionUseCase, then into EntryConfirmScreen. Blocked with a clear message when recipe.totalWeightG <= 0.

acceptanceCriteria: Editing a recipe does not alter previously logged entries
Running totals shown during editing exactly match the totals persisted on save
Cancelling the ingredient edit dialog leaves the list unchanged
Logging a portion of an empty recipe is impossible
tests: Running total recomputation after an in-place ingredient edit
Cancel discards
Save persists the edited ingredient set atomically
Portion scaling with a zero-weight recipe is blocked, not NaN
Compose tests for the pre-populated dialog across manual and API-sourced ingredients

layers.name: Hardening and release readiness
layers.goal: Cross-cutting quality work once all features exist.

components.name: R8 / ProGuard
components.responsibility: Keep rules for kotlinx.serialization serializers, Room, Hilt and ML Kit. Verify a release build actually parses both APIs.

components.name: Accessibility and density pass
components.responsibility: Content descriptions, touch targets, large-font and TalkBack behaviour on the dense data screens. LazyColumn stable keys and pre-formatted display strings to avoid per-recomposition formatting.

components.name: Edge-to-edge and predictive back
components.responsibility: Verify against targetSdk 36 behaviour on API 29 and on the newest available API level.

components.name: End-to-end verification
components.responsibility: Log an entry via each of the four methods plus a recipe portion, verify Today and both summary windows, delete an entry, run maintenance.

acceptanceCriteria: Release build passes the same test suite as debug
No plaintext API key in the release artefact's strings or logs
App is usable end to end with the network disabled
tests: Full instrumentation pass on API 29 and the newest available emulator image

criticalPathNotes: Layers 00 to 08 are non-UI and can proceed before design.md exists.
The two highest-risk correctness areas are the kJ/kcal conversion (layer 06) and the 20:00 rolling window plus resume-refresh behaviour (layers 02 and 12). Both have mandatory dedicated tests.
Sum-first-round-last (architecture.md 9.4) is a whole-app invariant, not a single layer's concern.
